content: Relation of BswModuleCallPoint to ExclusiveAre- aNestingOrder In case other BswModuleEntity s are called from within the BswModuleEntity the ExclusiveAreaNestingOrder can then be referenced by one or several BswModuleCallPoint s to specify the calling environment of the in- voked function with regard to ExclusiveArea s.
